question: How do the Rudras ascend after their office in Rudra's city ends?
premises: When their office is exhausted, they do not remain in the same place.
They ascend together with the group of Rudra's daughters.
They move from city to city above Rudra in ever higher stages.
inference: The Rudra realm is part of a graduated ascent in which office-bearing beings rise through successive higher cities.
plain_english: When their office comes to an end, they ascend together with the group of Rudra's daughters, going from city to city above Rudra in ever higher stages.
